cases.input: A prior producer PASS is kept as current closure proof after a later material review finding establishes a real Issue.
Issue root-cause state is promoted to SUPPORTED/CONFIRMED with no evidence reference or bounded scope.
Repair is implemented and producer retest passes; Issue is closed while required higher review is still pending, and parent design state is also auto-closed.
Material repair exists but defect→repair→retest lineage and invalidated prior receipts are not retained.
A post-hoc Issue is rewritten as though it had been a pre-existing Risk; another Risk is realized by mutating the Risk record in place instead of linking a distinct Issue.
A latent defect is retrospectively called Risk because it had no prior impact, detection time is rewritten as origin, and repair/retest/impact-end/resolution are collapsed into one done timestamp.

A temporally coincident event is promoted to root cause without causal basis; a material incident is represented by one generic cause field despite multiple material causal roles; containment urgency is used to raise causal confidence.
Issue closure automatically sets related residual/future risk to zero and a material postmortem records failure cause but omits why detection failed and any detection-control change.
An unresolved TBR value is converted to fact/Assumption without rationale, owner, resolution action/date, claim ceiling, or an authorized Assumption admission event.
An Assumption is refuted but only one of several affected Decision/Requirement/Interface/Assurance dependencies is reopened.
